events.title: Gold Holds Near Fourteen-month Low
events.description: Gold prices hovered near a fourteen-month low on Tuesday, weighed down by the headwinds of a stronger dollar, higher Treasury yields and tech-led liquidations.

events.title: Oil Prices Little Changed In Lackluster Trade As Oversupply Concerns Weigh
events.description: Oil prices were little changed on Tuesday as signs of recovering oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz added to expectations of stronger global supply and offset concerns about continued attacks on tankers in the region.

events.title: Commodity Currencies Slide Amid Risk-Off Mood
events.description: The commodity currencies such as the Australia, the New Zealand and the Canadian dollars weakened against their major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday, as Asian stock markets traded lower as traders remained cautious and concerned over AI stock valuations and persistent global inflation risk. Traders looked ahead to Nvidia's results and Anthropic's expected listing for additional clues about the future of the AI trade. Uncertainty and stalemate in the Middle East are also weighing on market sentiment.

events.title: European Shares Extend Losses As US Tightens AI Chip Export Restrictions
events.description: European stocks edged lower on Tuesday following reports that the United States is preparing to tighten restrictions on China's access to advanced artificial intelligence chips.

events.title: Asian Shares Follow Wall Street Lower Ahead Of Nvidia Earnings
events.description: Asian stocks followed Wall Street lower on Tuesday as investors rotated from AI stocks and sought direction on the Federal Reserve's interest rate path.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Drops Against Most Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar weakened against most major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday.

events.title: NZ Dollar Slides Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Lower As Eyes Turn To Nvidia Earnings
events.description: European stocks are seen opening on a sluggish note on Tuesday, following more drops for shares in the artificial intelligence industry on Wall Street overnight.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Early Trade
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher on Tuesday despite weak cues from global markets.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market trading on Tuesday, adding to the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,900 level, with weakness across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Lower
events.description: Asian markets are mostly lower on Tuesday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as traders remained concerned over AI stock valuations and persistent global inflation risk. Traders looked ahead to Nvidia's results and Anthropic's expected listing for additional clues about the future of the AI trade. Uncertainty in the Middle East is also weighing on market sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening Higher Despite Weak Global Cues
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Tuesday, with underlying sentiment likely to be underpinned by falling oil prices, an ongoing AI sell-off in global markets and continued foreign investor inflows.
